byPath.*: Selects the cheapest carrier that can take a shipment: quotes every carrier with its rate card and dimensional weight, and excludes carriers by their limits
byPath.Carrier: The profile of a carrier: services, dimensional weight divisor, limits and surcharges
byPath.CarrierQuotes: The quote of every carrier, the eligible quotes and the excluded carriers with their reasons
byPath.CarrierSelection: The cheapest eligible carrier, the fastest among equal prices, and the ranking of the eligible carriers
byPath.Package: One package: length, width and height in centimetres, and weight in kilograms
byPath.PackageFacts: The volume, the longest side and the length plus girth of one package
byPath.Shipment: A shipment: the destination zone, the service level, the residential flag, the declared value, the hazardous flag and the packages
byPath.ShipmentFacts: The number of packages, the actual weight, the heaviest package and the largest package of the shipment
byPath.billableKg: The billable weight of one package: the actual or the dimensional weight, whichever is larger, rounded up
byPath.carrierQuote: The quote of one carrier: the exclusions, the billable weight, the transport, fuel, residential and insurance charges, the price and the days
byPath.carrierRestrictions: Every limit of a carrier that the shipment breaks, with the reason
byPath.carriers: The profiles of the four carriers
byPath.hazardousBook: Hazardous goods by express: only one carrier can take them
byPath.homeDeliveryBook: Two boxes to a home address: three carriers can take them, the post cannot
byPath.selectCarrier: Selects the carrier of a shipment and returns the price, the ranking and the excluded carriers
byPath.shippingPolicy: The parameters of the shipping policy: the declared value that is insured for free
byPath.zoneRate: The rate card: the base price, the price per kilogram and the transit days by carrier, service and zone
